events.text: Construction began on Phase I of Line 15 in Shunyi District.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Construction began on Phase I of Line 15 in Shunyi District on April 11 , 2009 .

events.text: The easternmost Shunyi section of Phase I would be opened first.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the easternmost Shunyi section of Phase I ( in length with seven stations ) would be opened first on December 30 , 2011 .

events.text: The remainder of Phase I would follow.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The remainder of Phase I would follow in May 2013 .

events.text: Phase II plans showed the western half of Line 15 running from Xiyuan Station.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 2009 , Phase II plans showed the western half of Line 15 running from Xiyuan Station

events.subject: self
events.quote: When track-laying began in Phase I on October 28 , 2009

events.text: The first section from Wangjing West to Houshayu opened.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The first section of , from Wangjing West to Houshayu , opened on December 30 , 2010 .

events.text: The second section from Houshayu to Fengbo followed.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The second , from Houshayu to Fengbo , followed at the end of 2011 .

events.text: The third section from Qinghuadongluxikou to Wangjing West opened.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The third section , from Qinghuadongluxikou to Wangjing West , opened on December 28 , 2014 .

events.text: Wangjing East station did not open.
